notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Realms attached to Ornithopter.
description:
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Phyrexian Altar to add {W}.
Sword of the Realms returns Ornithopter to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter.
Pay {W} to equip Sword of the Realms to Ornithopter.
Repeat.

uses.name: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms
